purpose: Freeze source-semantic resolution requirements for the remaining difficult constituent accounting cases before any holdout target is opened.

resolution_requires: source identity and publication timestamp frozen before numerical comparison
corporate-action continuity reconciled where share count is used
machine-reproducible artifact hash where retrieval is available
unavailable evidence remains an explicit gap

cases.known_evidence: Six first-party development packets are frozen by reporting period/publication date; GitHub Actions historically receives HTTP 403 from issuer CDN.
frozen_semantics: 31-Dec-2022 remains latest eligible audited annual book source for Sep-2023 through Feb-2024 development signals
31-Dec-2023 result may enter TTM only after its 07-Feb-2024 publication
31-Dec-2023 twelve-month result is unaudited and cannot replace audited annual book source
cases.completion_gate: All required numerical facts must be reproducibly extracted from a frozen first-party or higher-priority official artifact without weakening the issuer-specific preregistration. A 403 is not permission to substitute a secondary source.

cases.known_evidence: Three selected historical structured XML links for Dec-2022, Mar-2023 and Jun-2023 returned 404 in the frozen development inventory.
cases.completion_gate: Recover the exact official filing from an NSE/NSE-archive route with period and dissemination identity preserved, or retain an explicit gap. Do not reconstruct missing quarterly facts from later YTD values under semantics v1.

Choose or reject candidates from official template/accounting semantics independent of six-month valuation fit; treatment of revaluation reserves, minority interest and total-company basis must be explicit.
Resolve from official NBFC filing semantics independently of development-target closeness; generic ordinary-company IndAS mapping may not be inherited by default.
Freeze an insurer-specific profit, annual net-worth and share-count extraction mapping from official insurance result packets. Do not force INDAS, BANKING or NBFC mappings.

cases.known_evidence: Development inventory observed an orders-of-magnitude implied-share discontinuity around Mar/Jun-2023 from paid-up-capital/face-value facts.
cases.completion_gate: Reconcile the candidate share-count facts to adjacent official filings and point-in-time official corporate actions. If no matching capital action explains the discontinuity, reject the anomalous fact/context rather than smoothing or carrying it forward.

milestone_gate.note: Even a successful six-month development reconstruction does not itself open the holdout. The reconstruction engine and mappings must be separately frozen first.
